originalInput.name: Workplace review
originalInput.question: Which randomized workplace interventions concern adult office workers?

criteria.label: Population
criteria.include: Adult office employees working at desks in a workplace.
criteria.exclude: School children and teenage pupils attending primary or secondary school.

criteria.label: Study design
criteria.include: Randomized controlled trial assigning participants to intervention and control groups.
criteria.exclude: Observational cross-sectional questionnaire survey with no intervention or randomized assignment.

papers.title: Standing breaks at work
papers.text: Adult office employees at desks were randomly assigned to a standing-break intervention or a control group in a randomized controlled trial.

papers.title: Movement in the classroom
papers.text: Primary school children and teenage pupils were randomly assigned to an exercise intervention or a control group in a randomized controlled trial.

papers.title: Desk workers survey
papers.text: Adult office employees working at desks completed an observational cross-sectional questionnaire survey. No intervention or randomized assignment was used.

papers.text: Adult office workers in a workplace were assigned randomly to intervention and control groups for a randomized controlled trial of active desks.
